# Test Fixtures

| File | What it is | Used by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sample.pdf` | A hand-built, single-page PDF containing one line of text. 601 bytes. Valid according to the PDF header and trailer rules, and opens in any viewer. | The API round-trip tests and the container smoke test. |
| `sample.png` | A 2 by 2 pixel white PNG. 71 bytes. | The API tests, to cover the image path alongside the PDF path. |

Both were generated by a short Python script rather than copied from anywhere,
so there are no licensing questions and they stay tiny.

## Still to add: expected OCR output

Phase 1 of the implementation plan asks for three real documents together with
the output the pipeline produced for them, so that later changes can be checked
against a known-good baseline. Those do not exist yet, because the first
end-to-end run (Track 1 in `next-steps.md`) has not completed successfully.

When it does, add for each document:

- `documents/<name>.pdf` (or `.png`), something you are comfortable committing
  publicly.
- `expected/<name>.md`, the Markdown the pipeline produced, reviewed by a person
  and corrected where the pipeline was wrong.
- `expected/<name>.layout.json`, the layout JSON.

Do not commit anything confidential. These files are public once the repository
is.
